transcript.text: This is Swift, an automated flood assistant working with local emergency services. Am I speaking with someone at 922 Kassikay Drive?
Yes, this is 922 Kassikay Drive. I’m here with two people. No water inside. I can help with a boat.
Thanks for confirming and offering to help with a boat. How many people are at the home right now, including anyone who can't come to the phone?
Two people are here. No one can’t come to the phone.

Thank you for letting us know about the people here. Is there anyone there who can't leave on their own, for example someone who uses a wheelchair, needs oxygen, or is bedbound? If it's a wheelchair, does it have a motor?
No one here can’t leave on their own. No wheelchair or medical needs.
Thanks for letting us know everyone can leave on their own. Is there water inside the home right now?
No water inside. Everyone can leave on their own.
Understood, no water inside, everyone can leave on their own. If neighbors need a ride out, do you have a high-clearance truck, a boat, or free seats in a vehicle?
I don’t have a truck or boat. No free seats in a vehicle either.
Understood, no truck, boat, or free seats available. Let me read that back: 2 people; no water inside yet. Is that right?
Yes. Two people. No water inside. Boat available.
Got it. Two people. No water inside. Boat available. I've recorded that everyone there can leave on their own. Don't drive through flooded roads. Turn around, don't drown. Goodbye.
